sentences.en: The authorities met with unyielding opposition from the locals.
sentences.zh: 当局遇到了当地居民顽固的反对。

sentences.en: His unyielding character doesn't please me at all.
sentences.zh: 他的顽强性格让我一点也高兴不起来。

sentences.en: The unyielding wind kept knocking over the tents.
sentences.zh: 狂风不断地把帐篷吹倒。

senses.zh: 坚硬的，不能弯曲的，不屈的,刚强,不屈服,倔强

mnemonic: 词根记忆：un（不）+yielding（易弯曲的） →不能弯曲的
